title: Meet the man reviving the ancient tradition of Scottish stone lifting
description: AN ANCIENT Scottish tradition once on the brink of disappearing is enjoying a surge in popularity, but enthusiasts have warned the growing interest could put centuries-old lifting stones at risk.
